teachingMeaningZh: 替某人省下時間，使他能更自主安排用途。

teachingMeaningZh: 在較大社群或組織中，特別活躍又重要的中心場所、活動或群體。

normalizedTeachingForm: take someone or something for granted

teachingMeaningEn: Remain essentially the same while appearing in a different form.
teachingMeaningZh: 本質大致仍在，只以另一種形式出現。

teachingMeaningEn: Come together to support someone facing difficulty or a shared cause.
teachingMeaningZh: 大家走在一起，支持面對困難的人或共同事情。

teachingMeaningEn: Directly between people living near one another.
teachingMeaningZh: 直接在住得近的居民之間。

teachingMeaningEn: Make contact or offer support through varied methods.
teachingMeaningZh: 透過不同方法主動聯絡或提供支持。

teachingMeaningEn: Remain cautious and ready to protect oneself against possible trouble.
teachingMeaningZh: 保持小心，預備防範可能的麻煩。

teachingForm: trust has not exactly dried up
teachingMeaningEn: Trust has not disappeared completely, expressed through a cautious denial of total loss.
teachingMeaningZh: 以謹慎否定完全消失的方式，說信任並非全無。

teachingForm: read the small print of human behaviour
teachingMeaningEn: Attend carefully to the less obvious details in what people do, not only their appealing words.
teachingMeaningZh: 仔細留意人們行動中不顯眼的細節，不只聽討好的話。

teachingForm: at the drop of a hat
teachingMeaningEn: Readily and immediately, without needing much prompting or preparation.
teachingMeaningZh: 很容易便立即去做，不需多次催促或長準備。

teachingMeaningEn: As a single complete effort or batch rather than in separate stages.
teachingMeaningZh: 以一次完整行動或一批做，而不是分階段。

teachingMeaningEn: A more reliable basis of evidence, principles or experience on which to depend.
teachingMeaningZh: 更可靠、可依靠的證據、原則或經驗基礎。

teachingMeaningEn: Small, often unnoticed actions that connect people and help a group hold together.
teachingMeaningZh: 細小、常不受注意，卻連接大家及維繫群體的行動。

teachingForm: keeps the social fabric from coming apart
teachingMeaningEn: Help maintain the relationships and cooperation that hold a community together.
teachingMeaningZh: 幫助維持使社群連結的關係與合作。

teachingForm: take the rough edges off daily life
teachingMeaningEn: Make ordinary life less awkward, difficult or stressful through small improvements or support.
teachingMeaningZh: 透過小改善或支持，減少日常生活的不便、困難或壓力。

teachingMeaningEn: Become clearly apparent or understandable as a fuller picture emerges.
teachingMeaningZh: 隨較完整情況出現，變得清楚可見或可理解。

teachingMeaningEn: Unite as a group to defend or support its members in response to an outside challenge.
teachingMeaningZh: 面對外來挑戰時，群體團結起來保護或支持成員。

teachingMeaningEn: When a difficulty arrives or makes itself felt, using the image of a visitor at the door.
teachingMeaningZh: 以訪客敲門作意象，指困難出現或開始影響生活。

teachingForm: does not make a big noise
teachingMeaningEn: Happen or have an effect without much publicity or fuss.
teachingMeaningZh: 沒有很多宣傳或張揚，卻仍發生或產生作用。

teachingForm: the world does not revolve around them
teachingMeaningEn: Other people’s needs and perspectives matter too; one person is not the centre of everything.
teachingMeaningZh: 別人的需要及觀點同樣重要，不能只以一個人作中心。

teachingForm: look up, look around, and step outside themselves
teachingMeaningEn: Notice the people around oneself and consider needs beyond one’s own immediate concerns.
teachingMeaningZh: 留意身邊的人，考慮自己眼前關注以外的需要。

teachingForm: leave a long shadow in a good way
teachingMeaningEn: Have a lasting positive influence, with an explicit qualifier reversing the often negative shadow image.
teachingMeaningZh: 留下長久正面影響；以明說好的一面，改變陰影常有的負面聯想。

teachingMeaningEn: Tolerate unacceptable conduct rather than objecting or responding.
teachingMeaningZh: 容忍不恰當行為，而不提出異議或回應。

teachingMeaningEn: Show the behaviour one hopes others will follow through one’s own actions.
teachingMeaningZh: 透過自己行動，示範希望別人跟隨的做法。

teachingForm: kindness is often caught before it is taught
teachingMeaningEn: People often begin learning caring behaviour by observing it before receiving explicit instruction.
teachingMeaningZh: 人往往先觀察並學到關懷行為，之後才獲明確教導。

teachingMeaningEn: Regard a named activity as an unwelcome duty rather than something one wants to do.
teachingMeaningZh: 把某項已提及活動視為不想做的責任，而不是自願有趣的事。

teachingMeaningEn: Become understood or absorbed after someone has had time or relevant experience.
teachingMeaningZh: 經過時間或相關經驗後，逐漸理解、吸收一個意思。

teachingMeaningEn: Offer support out of sincere concern rather than merely for show or reward.
teachingMeaningZh: 出於真誠關心而幫忙，不只是做給人看或為獎勵。

teachingForm: small seeds often grow into strong habits
teachingMeaningEn: Small early actions can develop through repetition into established patterns of behaviour.
teachingMeaningZh: 細小的早期行動，可透過反覆實行發展成穩固行為習慣。

teachingForm: not a grand performance but a quiet habit of the heart
teachingMeaningEn: Care presented as sincere, repeated practice rather than a show intended mainly to attract attention.
teachingMeaningZh: 把關懷看成真誠反覆實行，而非主要為引人注意的表演。

teachingForm: two heads are often better than one
teachingMeaningEn: Two people thinking together can often find better ideas or solutions than one person alone.
teachingMeaningZh: 兩人一起思考，常可比一人獨想有較好想法或解法。

teachingMeaningEn: Help someone become happier or less unhappy.
teachingMeaningZh: 令某人較開心，或減少不快。

teachingForm: not the end of the world
teachingMeaningEn: A setback that is disappointing but not a complete disaster.
teachingMeaningZh: 雖令人失望，卻不是無可挽回的大災難。

teachingMeaningEn: Become increasingly unsure about one’s own ability or judgement.
teachingMeaningZh: 對自己的能力或判斷，逐漸變得更不確定。

teachingMeaningEn: Help one another make progress through reciprocal support or encouragement.
teachingMeaningZh: 透過互相支持或鼓勵，幫彼此前進。

teachingMeaningEn: Origins or earlier connections extending into a more distant past.
teachingMeaningZh: 可追溯到較久以前的起源或連繫。

teachingForm: the long shadow behind the present
teachingMeaningEn: The continuing influence of earlier events on the situation that exists now.
teachingMeaningZh: 早前事件對現在情況仍持續的影響。

teachingMeaningEn: Appear seemingly without an earlier cause, process or background.
teachingMeaningZh: 看似沒有早前原因、過程或背景而出現。

teachingMeaningEn: Needed information that helps complete or connect an explanation.
teachingMeaningZh: 幫助補全或連起解釋的所缺資料。

teachingMeaningEn: Earlier events that explain a person, situation or story in the present.
teachingMeaningZh: 解釋人物、情況或故事的先前事件與背景。

teachingMeaningEn: History frequently shows recognisable similarities across different circumstances without repeating exactly.
teachingMeaningZh: 歷史在不同情況中常見可辨認的相似模式，並非原樣重演。

teachingMeaningEn: A sign suggesting a possible problem and a need for attention or caution.
teachingMeaningZh: 顯示可能有問題、值得留意或謹慎的警號。

teachingMeaningEn: Deliberately ignore wrongdoing or a problem one is aware of.
teachingMeaningZh: 明知有不當行為或問題，卻故意不理會。

teachingMeaningEn: Desire for more gain operates without effective restraint.
teachingMeaningZh: 想獲取更多利益的貪念失去有效約束。

teachingForm: pulled themselves back from the brink
teachingMeaningEn: Recover through action from a situation very close to serious failure or disaster.
teachingMeaningZh: 透過行動，從非常接近嚴重失敗或災難的情況挽回。

teachingMeaningEn: An account of the past that feels connected to human experience and continuing life.
teachingMeaningZh: 讓人感受到人的經歷及延續生活的歷史敘述。

teachingMeaningEn: A lifeless collection of historical dates without meaningful connections or human experience.
teachingMeaningZh: 缺少有意義連接或人的經歷，只剩死板歷史日期。

teachingMeaningEn: With awareness of relevant facts, difficulties or risks rather than in ignorance of them.
teachingMeaningZh: 對相關事實、困難或風險有認識，而非未知便作選擇。

teachingMeaningEn: Historical context that helps explain the visible geography or social arrangement of a place.
teachingMeaningZh: 幫助解釋現有地理或社會安排的歷史脈絡。

teachingMeaningEn: Become clearer or easier to understand as information or relationships become apparent.
teachingMeaningZh: 資料或關係明朗後，逐漸變得較清楚、易理解。

teachingMeaningEn: Difficult or tiring to follow or continue, especially reading or an activity.
teachingMeaningZh: 尤其指閱讀或某活動難跟上、做下去吃力。

teachingMeaningEn: Facts presented in an unengaging way without context or a sense of why they matter.
teachingMeaningZh: 呈現得沒趣、欠脈絡或意義連接的事實。

teachingMeaningEn: Active engagement with historical evidence through questions, interpretation and response.
teachingMeaningZh: 透過提問、理解及回應，主動與歷史資料交流。

teachingForm: a dusty shelf of dead facts
teachingMeaningEn: A disengaging presentation of historical information stored without meaningful human or causal connections.
teachingMeaningZh: 歷史資料像被擱置、缺少人的經歷或因果連接，呈現得沒生命。

teachingMeaningEn: Make a historical account feel connected with human life and experience rather than only numerical information.
teachingMeaningZh: 讓歷史敘述連到人的生活經歷，不只剩數字資料。

teachingMeaningEn: Authority is exercised without effective oversight, challenge or limits.
teachingMeaningZh: 權力在缺少有效監察、質疑或限制下被行使。

teachingMeaningEn: A way to learn from earlier events while making choices about what comes next.
teachingMeaningZh: 在向前作選擇時，用來了解過去經驗的方法。

teachingMeaningEn: Have a stronger emotional impact than something else or than before.
teachingMeaningZh: 比另一事物或以前帶來更強情緒衝擊。

teachingMeaningEn: Interpret present choices by considering earlier experiences and historical conditions.
teachingMeaningZh: 考慮早前經驗與歷史情況，理解目前選擇。

teachingForm: one chapter in a much longer story
teachingMeaningEn: One period or generation within a broader continuing history.
teachingMeaningZh: 較廣而延續的歷史中，一個時期或一代人。

teachingMeaningEn: Achieved or gained only after considerable effort or difficulty.
teachingMeaningZh: 經相當努力或困難才取得。

teachingMeaningEn: Provide every needed solution ready-made, with the receiver doing no further reasoning.
teachingMeaningZh: 把所需解答全都現成提供，接收者不用再思考。

teachingMeaningEn: Concrete human detail that makes an account feel populated by real lives and experiences.
teachingMeaningZh: 讓敘述有人的生活經歷、較具體可感的細節。

teachingMeaningEn: The basic factual framework of the past, such as dates, sequence and key events.
teachingMeaningZh: 例如日期、順序及主要事件等過去的基本事實結構。

teachingMeaningEn: The human experiences and circumstances underlying factual information.
teachingMeaningZh: 事實資料背後的人們經歷與生活處境。

teachingMeaningEn: Understand how separate pieces of information relate, with emotionally specifying a human feeling or meaning in context.
teachingMeaningZh: 理解分散資料怎互相關連；emotionally 在情境中強調人的感受或意義。

teachingForm: more than one door into the past
teachingMeaningEn: Several possible routes or methods for beginning to learn about history.
teachingMeaningZh: 開始學習歷史可有不只一種方法或途徑。

teachingMeaningEn: An engaging starting route that invites further learning about the past.
teachingMeaningZh: 吸引人開始、引向進一步了解過去的途徑。

teachingMeaningEn: The suffering or burdens people experience as a consequence of a named event or decision.
teachingMeaningZh: 某項已指明事件或決定，令當事人承受的痛苦或負擔。

teachingMeaningEn: Every small step or detail along the course of an event or development.
teachingMeaningZh: 某事件或發展過程中，每一小步或細節。

teachingMeaningEn: The broad outline of a complex subject or event rather than every detailed part.
teachingMeaningZh: 複雜主題或事件的大致輪廓，而非每項細節。

teachingForm: a gateway rather than a final authority
teachingMeaningEn: A useful entry point for further learning, not a source that settles every question definitively.
teachingMeaningZh: 有助進一步學習的入門途徑，而非能最終確定每個問題的來源。

teachingMeaningEn: A more complete understanding gained by adding relevant information or perspectives.
teachingMeaningZh: 加入相關資料或角度後，較完整的理解。

teachingMeaningEn: Make historical events or experiences feel vivid and engaging in their presentation.
teachingMeaningZh: 在呈現中令過去事件或經歷生動而可感。

teachingForm: a gold mine, but it can also be a minefield
teachingMeaningEn: A rich source of useful material that can also contain errors, uncertainty or hazards requiring care.
teachingMeaningZh: 有豐富有用資料，也可能有錯誤、未知或需小心的陷阱。

teachingForm: shaky at best and misleading at worst
teachingMeaningEn: Unreliable even under a favourable assessment, and potentially giving a false impression under a worse one.
teachingMeaningZh: 即使較寬鬆評估也不穩妥，較差時更可能令人誤解。

teachingMeaningEn: Examine only superficial features without pursuing the deeper details or explanation.
teachingMeaningZh: 只看表面特徵，沒追更深細節或解釋。

teachingMeaningEn: Promote a specific objective or viewpoint, often through selective presentation.
teachingMeaningZh: 推動某特定目標或觀點，常以選擇性呈現支持。

teachingMeaningEn: Careful, clear-minded attention that checks appearances and claims rather than accepting them uncritically.
teachingMeaningZh: 清醒仔細地檢視外觀與聲稱，不是不加思考便接受。

teachingMeaningEn: Become vivid and immediate in the imagination or through a presentation beyond plain written description.
teachingMeaningZh: 在想像或呈現中變得鮮活、近在眼前，不只停在平面描述。

teachingMeaningEn: Keep consuming successive items of content instead of pausing to think about their meaning or evidence.
teachingMeaningZh: 不斷接着看內容，而非停下想其意思或依據。

teachingForm: bring the past into sharp focus
teachingMeaningEn: Make historical circumstances or relationships clearer and easier to understand.
teachingMeaningZh: 讓歷史情況或關係更清楚、容易理解。

teachingMeaningEn: Make a situation or account harder to understand accurately.
teachingMeaningZh: 令情況或敘述更難準確理解。

teachingMeaningEn: Feel able to think more clearly after a period of tiredness or mental confusion.
teachingMeaningZh: 在疲累或思緒混亂後，感到較能清楚思考。

teachingMeaningEn: Take a temporary break from everyday duties, demands or pressures.
teachingMeaningZh: 暫時離開日常責任、要求或壓力。

teachingMeaningEn: Without repeatedly checking the time because of pressure to stop or move to the next obligation.
teachingMeaningZh: 不用因趕下一項安排或快要結束，而反覆留意時間。

teachingMeaningEn: Continue to exist or matter after the journey has ended.
teachingMeaningZh: 旅程結束後，某種關係、影響或感受仍然延續。

teachingForm: The bags are put away, but the memories stay with us
teachingMeaningEn: The journey and practical unpacking are over, while its remembered experiences remain present in everyday life.
teachingMeaningZh: 旅行和整理行李已結束，但經歷仍被記起、留在日常生活。

teachingMeaningEn: Follow separate routines or directions with little shared time or coordination.
teachingMeaningZh: 各自沿不同生活安排或方向前進，缺少共同時間或配合。

teachingMeaningEn: Temporarily interrupt a named repeated pattern, with a later return possible.
teachingMeaningZh: 暫時中斷已指明的重複安排，之後仍可能回復。

teachingMeaningEn: An experience that feels like a chance to start afresh or mentally reorganise after a difficult or repetitive period.
teachingMeaningZh: 一段經歷令人感到有機會重新開始，或在困難、重複日子後整理思緒。

teachingMeaningEn: Looking completely beautiful or ideal, as if arranged for a perfect picture.
teachingMeaningZh: 外觀看來完美漂亮，像精心安排的理想畫面。

teachingMeaningEn: An attractive scenic appearance, considered like the polished image on a postcard.
teachingMeaningZh: 像明信片上經過選取、漂亮悅目的風景外觀。

teachingMeaningEn: A perspective on a place or experience that attends to people and their connections, rather than scenery alone.
teachingMeaningZh: 看待地方或經歷時，留意人的生活和連繫，不只景色。

teachingForm: bring people back to one another
teachingMeaningEn: Help people regain a sense of closeness or connection after distance or separation.
teachingMeaningZh: 在人與人疏遠或分隔後，幫他們重新感到親近或連繫。

teachingMeaningEn: Alter a plan or direction because of a sudden passing wish rather than a considered reason.
teachingMeaningZh: 因突然、短暫的念頭而改變計劃或方向，而非經仔細考慮。

teachingMeaningEn: Feeling unusually free or unconstrained, expressed through an image of breathing fully.
teachingMeaningZh: 透過充分呼吸的畫面，表達格外自由、不受束縛的感受。

teachingMeaningEn: In a way or under conditions that the person chooses or accepts for themselves.
teachingMeaningZh: 按當事人自行選擇或接受的方式和條件行事。

teachingMeaningEn: A period of self-reflection in which someone considers their own feelings, questions or choices.
teachingMeaningZh: 反思自己的感受、問題或選擇，彷彿與自己交談的一段時間。

teachingMeaningEn: Mental or emotional room to reflect, feel calm or attend to one’s own thoughts.
teachingMeaningZh: 心裏可反思、感到安靜或留意自己想法的餘地。

teachingForm: go from being ... to something people can shape
teachingMeaningEn: Change from a previously fixed or occasional experience into one whose form people can influence.
teachingMeaningZh: 由以往較固定或偶爾舉行的經驗，變成參與者可影響其形式的事。

teachingMeaningEn: Accumulate money over time for a particular planned purchase or expense.
teachingMeaningZh: 一段時間逐步積存金錢，準備支付某項購買或開支。

teachingMeaningEn: Close to the relevant departure, event or deadline, leaving little advance notice; last-minute describes a late arrangement, while at the last minute locates an action or change.
teachingMeaningZh: 在相關出發、事件或期限前不久，預先通知時間很短；last-minute 可形容臨時安排，at the last minute 則說明行動或改變發生的時機。

teachingForm: modern life tends to follow people wherever they go
teachingMeaningEn: Everyday demands, especially work and digital contact, can continue to reach people even when they change location.
teachingMeaningZh: 即使人換了地方，日常要求，尤其工作及數碼聯絡，仍可能持續找上門。

teachingForm: a change of scenery with Wi-Fi
teachingMeaningEn: A pointed description of travel that changes the surroundings while leaving ordinary work or digital distractions largely intact.
teachingMeaningZh: 帶點批評地形容只換了環境，平常工作或數碼干擾卻大致照舊的旅行。

teachingMeaningEn: Reach a distant destination physically while remaining mentally caught in the routines one meant to leave.
teachingMeaningZh: 身體到達遠方，心裏卻仍被原想暫離的日常牽着。

teachingMeaningEn: A wider range of experiences, opportunities or places has become accessible to someone.
teachingMeaningZh: 對某人而言，可接觸的經驗、機會或地方範圍擴大了。

teachingForm: pack activities into a few days
teachingMeaningEn: Schedule many activities within a short period, often suggesting an overfull timetable when the context shows insufficient time.
teachingMeaningZh: 在短時間內排入很多活動；若情境顯示時間不足，常帶有行程太滿的意思。

teachingMeaningEn: A place whose qualities suit a person’s preferences or present needs.
teachingMeaningZh: 一個在特點上配合當事人喜好或當前需要的地方。

teachingMeaningEn: Completely exhausted or drained of energy.
teachingMeaningZh: 非常疲累，像精力被耗盡。

teachingForm: step out of their usual bubble
teachingMeaningEn: Move beyond familiar surroundings, contacts or assumptions to encounter other experiences or perspectives.
teachingMeaningZh: 走出熟悉環境、人際圈或想法，接觸其他經驗和觀點。

teachingMeaningEn: A mind enriched by added knowledge, broader experience, understanding or questions, using fullness as an image.
teachingMeaningZh: 以充實作比喻，指知識、經驗、理解或問題變得更豐富。

teachingForm: a change of world or simply a change of pace
teachingMeaningEn: A contrast between a substantially different environment and a change in the usual rhythm or activity.
teachingMeaningZh: 對比明顯不同的生活環境，與日常節奏或活動方式的改變。

teachingForm: stop feeling like a break and start feeling like a test
teachingMeaningEn: Change in someone’s experience from something restful into something demanding or stressful.
teachingMeaningZh: 對當事人而言，原本可休息的經歷逐漸變成費力或有壓力的事。

teachingForm: takes the shine off the trip
teachingMeaningEn: Reduce the pleasure, excitement or positive impression of a journey.
teachingMeaningZh: 減少旅程的樂趣、興奮或原有好印象。

teachingMeaningEn: An unpleasant or uneasy feeling that accumulates gradually rather than arriving all at once.
teachingMeaningZh: 不愉快或不自在的感受逐漸累積，而不是一次突然出現。

teachingForm: cast a shadow over the whole experience
teachingMeaningEn: Make an experience as a whole feel less positive through a troubling event or continuing concern.
teachingMeaningZh: 因令人不安的事件或持續顧慮，令整段經歷的感受較為負面。

teachingForm: life outgrows the space they are living in
teachingMeaningEn: Changing household needs make the existing living space feel insufficient or unsuitable.
teachingMeaningZh: 家庭生活需要改變，令原有住所的空間變得不足或不再合用。

teachingMeaningEn: Previously felt like a sheltered, comforting home, using a nest as the image.
teachingMeaningZh: 曾像一個可安歇、有溫暖感的家，以鳥窩作比喻。

teachingMeaningEn: Move on from a previous situation or stage towards a new one.
teachingMeaningZh: 從先前的情況或階段向前走，開始新的一頁。

teachingMeaningEn: Begin again, either from the beginning of a task or in a new situation.
teachingMeaningZh: 重新開始一項工作，或在新情況中重新起步。

teachingMeaningEn: At the most basic or fundamental level, beneath the apparent details.
teachingMeaningZh: 在最基本或根本的層面，透過表面細節看核心所在。

teachingForm: starting a chapter with the map missing
teachingMeaningEn: Beginning a new stage without knowing the practical systems or routes needed to navigate it.
teachingMeaningZh: 開始新階段時，還不熟悉應付日常所需的制度、方法或途徑。

teachingMeaningEn: Find a solution, explanation or workable arrangement through thought or discussion.

teachingForm: strong roots without becoming afraid to branch out

teachingForm: a fresh page rather than just a new address

teachingMeaningEn: Begin to settle in a place and build a stable life or continuing connections there.

teachingForm: at the mercy of rent increases

teachingMeaningZh: 容易受到自己難以充分控制的租金上調影響。

teachingForm: money disappearing into someone else’s pocket

teachingMeaningEn: Manage three competing tasks, demands or priorities at the same time.

teachingMeaningZh: 把別人的人生當逐項照做的劇本，過度仿照每個細節。

teachingMeaningZh: 透過引導或鼓勵，幫人看見可走的方向。

teachingForm: the water young people swim in

teachingMeaningZh: 廣泛包圍日常經驗的環境，這裏指年輕人生活中的網絡媒體。

teachingMeaningEn: Remain oriented towards a goal or guiding purpose while circumstances change.
teachingMeaningZh: 情況改變時，仍以目標或指導目的維持方向。

teachingMeaningZh: 提供指引，幫人看清可能的路向或下一步。

teachingMeaningEn: Directed strongly by achieving outcomes or measurable results.

teachingMeaningZh: 城市生活中不討喜、卻需要面對的實際條件；cold 比喻冷峻，不受願望或樂觀想法左右。

teachingMeaningEn: Offer generosity or emotional room despite limited physical space, through a deliberately poetic stretching image.
teachingMeaningZh: 以刻意帶詩意的伸展意象，形容地方雖小，仍能提供慷慨與情感上的容納。

teachingMeaningEn: A network of help already available as part of a household, group or arrangement, subject to its actual scope.
teachingMeaningZh: 家庭、群體或安排本身已有的互助網絡，實際範圍仍視具體情況而定。

teachingMeaningEn: Reduce a substantial practical or emotional burden, with real emphasising a meaningful degree of relief.
teachingMeaningZh: 減輕相當的實際或情緒負擔；real 強調確有意義的減輕程度。

teachingForm: living on top of one another
teachingMeaningEn: Live in crowded conditions with very little personal space or privacy.
teachingMeaningZh: 在擠迫環境中生活，個人空間或私隱很少。

teachingMeaningEn: Feel constrained or prevented from expressing ideas or developing freely in the stated context.
teachingMeaningZh: 在所述情境中，感到想法表達或自由發展受到限制與壓抑。

teachingMeaningEn: Something that brings a valued benefit while also creating difficulty or demands.
teachingMeaningZh: 某件事帶來值得珍惜的益處，同時也有困難或要求。

teachingMeaningEn: Behave very carefully to avoid offending or upsetting someone.
teachingMeaningZh: 為免冒犯或惹某人不快，在言行上非常小心。

teachingMeaningEn: A task intended for or manageable by one person; saying it is not a one-person job indicates that shared work or help is needed.
teachingMeaningZh: 由一個人負責或一人能應付的工作；說它不是一人工作，才表示需要分工或幫忙。

teachingMeaningEn: Take all the work or responsibility in the situation, pictured as carrying a complete burden.
teachingMeaningZh: 把全部負擔比作一整個重擔，形容獨力承擔所述情況中的所有工作或責任。

teachingForm: not a rigid fifty-fifty split on paper
teachingMeaningEn: Not merely an inflexible numerical division into equal halves written in a plan; actual needs and responsibilities also matter in context.
teachingMeaningZh: 不只是計劃上寫成兩等份而僵化執行；按情境，實際需要及責任也重要。

teachingMeaningEn: Withdraw attention or engagement completely in the stated activity or relationship.
teachingMeaningZh: 在所述活動或關係中，完全抽離注意力或不再投入。

teachingMeaningEn: Divided equally into two halves or, for a group or vote, two equal sides.
teachingMeaningZh: 平均分成兩半；用於群體或投票時，指兩邊數目相同。

teachingMeaningEn: Support a shared aim or act as allies in the stated matter, even if some views or preferences differ.
teachingMeaningZh: 在所談事情上支持共同目標或互作同伴，即使部分看法或偏好不同。

teachingMeaningEn: Gradually weaken someone’s confidence, resolve or emotional strength.
teachingMeaningZh: 逐漸削弱某人的信心、意志或心理承受力。
